test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.

The pizza was ordered by Nikita at 5 p.m.

options.text: Nikita has being ordered the pizza at 5 p.m.
Nikita has been ordered the pizza at 5 p.m.
Nikita had ordered the pizza at 5 p.m.
Nikita ordered the pizza at 5 p.m.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In Active Voice,** a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• **In Passive Voice, **a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice and **'The pizza'** is the subject and '**Nikita' **is the object.
 
• When we convert this sentence into active voice, the subject 'The pizza' of the passive voice becomes the object, the object 'Nikita' becomes the subject.
 
• The sentence is in the **Simple past tense.**
 
• The passive format** "was + ordered(V3)"** is used and the active format **"ordered (V2)"** should be used.
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the Simple past tense.

Hence, the correct active voice is **"Nikita ordered the pizza at 5 p.m."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• In voice change, we never change the tense.
